about_short_description.short_description: Allure Systems uses AI to produce apparel images for eCommerce.

product.name: Images On-demand with Creative AI
product.description: Allows fashion retailers to create images of apparel on virtual models in various sizes without needing physical models or photographers.

product.name: Model Virtualization
product.description: Transforms chosen models into virtual versions, including their poses and expressions, for use in creating on-brand apparel images.

product.name: Speed to Market
product.description: Enables rapid production of marketing images to reduce time from product availability to online listing.

product.name: Size Inclusivity
product.description: Produces images of apparel in various sizes to help customers find the perfect fit and reduce return rates.

product.name: Scalability
product.description: Supports the creation of a large number of on-brand images quickly for new inventory items.

product.name: Images for Wholesale and Marketplace
product.description: Generates images that meet the brand and format requirements of various resellers automatically.
